issueNumber.description: the gazette running issue number printed in the masthead, converted to arabic digits

issueDate.description: the gazette publication date printed in the masthead, normalized to iso YYYY-MM-DD; convert the japanese era year to the gregorian year

weekday.description: the day-of-week printed in the masthead, given as the english weekday name

imperialOrdinanceNumber.description: the number of the imperial ordinance (勅令) on the page, converted to arabic digits

imperialOrdinancePromulgationDate.description: the promulgation date stated under the imperial ordinance signatures, normalized to iso YYYY-MM-DD

ministerialOrdinanceNumber.description: the number of the ministry ordinance (省令) on the page, converted to arabic digits

coinFaceValueSen.description: the face value of the auxiliary coin specified by the imperial ordinance, in sen, as an integer

coinMaterial.description: the material (素材) of the coin as printed in the specification table

coinWeightGrams.description: the coin weight (量目) in grams as printed in the specification table

coinDiameterMm.description: the coin diameter (直径) in millimetres as printed in the specification table

courseTables.description: one entry per subject-row across every curriculum hours table on the page; a page carries several such tables, each headed by a course/track name

trackName.description: the course/track name heading the table this row belongs to, as printed

subject.description: the subject label (学科目) in this row, exactly as printed; include the total row whose label is the summation character

totalHours.description: the total class hours (授業総時数) for this subject, converting the printed kanji numerals to an arabic integer
